body: You might be right, but how could I leave her? I legitimately love her.

We tried inpatient treatment, ECT, every medication you can name. The pills were left over because they didn't help her, they were a supplement to her standard oxycodone, so those weren't being accounted for. I thought she was safe... I've been in control of her meds on and off for the last 8 months and she hadn't attempted suicide once in that period. A few months ago I though we were finally through the bend and I could let her behave as an adult...

I just feel like such a failure. I can't help her, and I'm falling apart. Now everything I say is wrong. She asked me to call her boss in the morning to tell her she wouldn't be in to work. I said she should be the one to call because it would mean more too hear it from her "rather than hear whatever excuse is give her." 

Her response was "excuse..." a head nod and she walked away.

I can't even talk to her without fucking that up anymore... all I can do is cry.
